verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's first-party Vertex AI pages say the platform lets teams "build, scale, govern, and optimize enterprise grade AI agents" and turn workflows into "agentic systems at global scale," which points to a shipped, managed agent home. However, the evidence is product-overview copy only: no named agent runtime, deployment or orchestration docs, or hands-on corroboration appear. The MCP servers and Toolbox are tooling for agents, not a runtime for hosting them. Missing for 10: specific documented agent runtime/hosting service, orchestration/session/memory documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, agents have a managed home — first-party agent runtimes/orchestration services shipped and documented, not just a blog vision

citations.quote: Build, scale, govern, and optimize enterprise grade AI agents
It provides the full-stack foundation and extensive developer choice you need to transform your applications and workflows into powerful agentic systems at global scale.
